tools.name: evidence_search
tools.title: Search research evidence
tools.description: Find citable passages in papers, notes, tables and UTF-8 files. Scopes and kinds form unions; all supplied tags must match the parent paper. Results include the source, locator, revision and citation.

items.description: Paper ID, Vault-relative path or opaque citation URI.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the same query.

vault.description: Authorized Vault ID. Omit to use the default Vault.

tools.name: evidence_read
tools.title: Read a passage
tools.description: Read by citation, paper or Vault path. Choose one of pages, section, region, quote or lines. A citation already selects its location. Layout needs one page or region. An unqualified paper returns metadata. Body reads prefer TeX, Markdown, layout, then native PDF text. Use next_cursor for longer reads. A restricted body citation reopens exactly the issued excerpt.

source.description: Paper ID, Vault-relative path or opaque citation URI.

pages.description: One-based physical page numbers. Use [8] for page eight. Pages are returned in order.

region.description: Identifier returned by a previous operation.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the same query.

vault.description: Authorized Vault ID. Omit to use the default Vault.

tools.name: paper_list
tools.title: List papers
tools.description: Filter by title, author, identifier, path, tags, reading state and status. All tags must match. Updated and publication dates sort newest first; titles sort ascending.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the same query.

vault.description: Authorized Vault ID. Omit to use the default Vault.

tools.name: paper_get
tools.title: Get paper details
tools.description: Get metadata, reading state, user tags and the Vault-relative locations of available local assets.

paper.description: Unique paper ID or Vault-relative paper directory.

vault.description: Authorized Vault ID. Omit to use the default Vault.

tools.name: paper_update
tools.title: Update paper metadata
tools.description: Update at least one catalog field or reading-state value. Author names replace the full ordered list. Use clear to remove optional values. Keep a nonempty title.

paper.description: Unique paper ID or Vault-relative paper directory.

if_revision.description: Opaque revision returned by the previous read.

vault.description: Authorized Vault ID. Omit to use the default Vault.

tools.name: paper_discover
tools.title: Discover papers
tools.description: Find arXiv candidates by keyword or category. Limit must fit within the candidate count. Hybrid ranking requires a configured embedding profile. When a Vault is selected, known papers are excluded by default.

embedding_profile.description: Identifier returned by a previous operation.

vault.description: Authorized Vault ID. Omit to use the default Vault.

tools.name: paper_import
tools.title: Import a paper
tools.description: Import a DOI, arXiv identifier or supported paper URL. Existing records are deduplicated by identifier. Results distinguish newly created and existing records and report asset status.

identifier.description: DOI, arXiv ID or supported paper URL.

vault.description: Authorized Vault ID. Omit to use the default Vault.

tools.name: paper_regions
tools.title: List paper regions
tools.description: List figures, tables, formulas or text regions with one-based physical pages, coordinates and citations. Filter by kind and page. Missing analysis returns a layout error.

paper.description: Unique paper ID or Vault-relative paper directory.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the same query.

vault.description: Authorized Vault ID. Omit to use the default Vault.

tools.name: paper_relations
tools.title: Find paper relations
tools.description: Inspect cached references, locally observed citations, or references matched to papers in the Vault. Results indicate coverage, match basis and cache state.

paper.description: Unique paper ID or Vault-relative paper directory.

vault.description: Authorized Vault ID. Omit to use the default Vault.

tools.description: Append Markdown to a paper's notes. Retry with the same request ID and content to append exactly once.

tools.title: Replace a paper note
tools.description: Replace the Markdown body of the paper's notes using its observed revision. Use missing to create notes. Locked experiment records remain protected.

paper.description: Unique paper ID or Vault-relative paper directory.

tools.name: file_list
tools.title: List Vault files
tools.description: List one directory level. Omit path for the Vault root. Hidden entries may be included; private and managed paths stay protected.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the same query.

vault.description: Authorized Vault ID. Omit to use the default Vault.

tools.name: file_write
tools.title: Write a Vault file
tools.description: Create, append or replace a file. Create requires an unused path, replace requires the current revision, and UTF-8 append requires a request ID. Use standard Base64 for binary data. Use dedicated tools for existing tables and paper notes.

if_revision.description: Opaque revision returned by the previous read.

request_id.description: Request ID of 1–80 characters without whitespace.

vault.description: Authorized Vault ID. Omit to use the default Vault.

content.description: Plain UTF-8 text or standard padded Base64. Maximum decoded size: 2 MiB.

tools.name: file_move
tools.title: Move a Vault file
tools.description: Move or rename a file or folder using its full destination path. Whole papers and their organizational folders can move across authorized Vaults while preserving the folder name. Existing destinations cause a conflict. Use dry_run to preview.

vault.description: Authorized Vault ID. Omit to use the default Vault.

tools.name: file_remove
tools.title: Move files to trash
tools.description: Move files and folders to the Vault trash, including catalog entries under removed paper folders. Returns IDs for restore. Use dry_run to preview.

vault.description: Authorized Vault ID. Omit to use the default Vault.

vault.description: Authorized Vault ID. Omit to use the default Vault.

tools.name: trash_restore
tools.title: Restore a trash entry
tools.description: Restore a trashed entry and its catalog data at the original path. An occupied destination leaves the entry in the trash.

id.description: Identifier returned by a previous operation.

vault.description: Authorized Vault ID. Omit to use the default Vault.

tools.name: annotation_add
tools.title: Add an annotation
tools.description: Select a citation from this paper, a free-form quote, or a layout region. Free-form quote matching needs full-text access. For a restricted reader, use a returned excerpt citation or region. Use occurrence or all_matches to disambiguate quotes. Ask requires a question. Translate requires a language and either supplied translation text or online access.

tools.description: Create or update records by ID. Only supplied fields change. The whole batch is validated and committed atomically. Repeating a request ID with identical input returns the original receipt.

id.description: Use an ID returned by table_query to update a row. A new registry ID has an ASCII letter, optional ASCII letters or digits, a hyphen and at least four digits, e.g. trial-0003.

tools.name: table_patch
tools.title: Patch table cells
tools.description: Set individual cells by record ID and field name. The rows and fields must exist. Duplicate coordinates are rejected. The batch commits atomically.
